semantic_differences: Cp/Cpk and specification-Z cases pass capability_indices tests; defect/rework yield cases pass process_yield tests.
Current LSS4PY binary funnel-stage yields are not equivalents of ss.ca.yield defect/rework vectors.
SixSigma DPU is the sum of defects in this API, not the defect count divided by a unit denominator.
Python rejects zero opportunities, invalid counts and excess loss; one eager frame requires aligned columns instead of R vector recycling.
R data-frame outputs, warning/error classes and nonfinite string encoding are retained; future Python typed-result and error contracts will differ.
Python sigma_shift is explicit, finite and nonnegative; 1.5 matches R LT=True. Neither shift convention demonstrates measured long-term variation.
